title: Deductive Chain-of-Thought Augmented Socially-aware Robot Navigation World Model
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'socially-aware' robot navigation, specifically adhering to social norms such as proxemics (personal space) and activity-specific distancing. While it discusses social norm compliance, this is defined through geometric and logical constraints for physical safety and etiquette rather than an evaluation of religion, theology, or broad ethical frameworks.
